newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: HMH Gold applies for Vancouver listing.
newsitem.headline: HMH Gold applies for Vancouver listing.

text.p: Gold explorer HMH Gold Mining Corp Ltd said on Friday it planned to apply for the interlisting of the company's securities on the Vancouver Stock Exchange (VSE) in Canada.
The company said it would maintain its listing on the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).

"The move to list on the VSE is expected to strengthen the international appeal of the company and in particular to raise the profile of the company in the Canadian market place where there has been sustained interest in the Indonesian gold sector," the company said in a statement.
HMH Gold has an interest in a number of gold exploration projects in Indonesia, including the Saran Hard Rock Gold project in West Kalimantan.
"The company has executed a sponsorship agreement with a Canadian brokerage firm, Brink, Hudson and Lefever Ltd, and expect the listing to be achieved during the current quarter," HMH Gold said.
The company said the VSE has accepted the company's pre-listing application and fact sheet which enabled its full application for listing to proceed.
